hooks.command: node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{const i=JSON.parse(d);const cmd=i.tool_input?.command||'';if(/gh pr create/.test(cmd)){const out=i.tool_output?.output||'';const m=out.match(/https:\/\/github.com\/[^/]+\/[^/]+\/pull\/\d+/);if(m){console.error('[Hook] PR created: '+m[0]);const repo=m[0].replace(/https:\/\/github.com\/([^/]+\/[^/]+)\/pull\/\d+/,'$1');const pr=m[0].replace(/.*\/pull\/(\d+)/,'$1');console.error('[Hook] To review: gh pr review '+pr+' --repo '+repo)}}console.log(d)})"

PostToolUse.description: Log PR URL and provide review command after PR creation

hooks.command: powershell -Command "$file_path = '{{file_path}}'; if (Test-Path $file_path -PathType Leaf) { $dir = Split-Path $file_path -Parent; $project = $dir; while ($project -and -not (Test-Path (Join-Path $project 'package.json') -PathType Leaf)) { $project = Split-Path $project -Parent }; if ($project -and (Test-Path (Join-Path $project 'package.json') -PathType Leaf)) { try { npx prettier --write $file_path 2>$null | Out-Null } catch {} } }"

PostToolUse.description: Auto-format JS/TS files with Prettier after edits

powershell -Command "$file_path = '{{file_path}}'; $content = Get-Content $file_path -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 5; if ($content -match 'console\\.log') { Write-Host '[Hook] WARNING: console.log found' -ForegroundColor Red; Select-String -Path $file_path -Pattern 'console\\.log' | ForEach-Object { Write-Host $_.Line -ForegroundColor DarkGray } }"

PostToolUse.description: Warn about console.log statements after edits

hooks.command: powershell -Command "$ErrorActionPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'; $git = (Get-Command git -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source; if (-not $git) { exit 0 }; $modified = & $git diff --name-only 2>$null | Where-Object { $_ -match '\\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$' }; if ($modified) { $hasConsole = $false; foreach ($f in $modified) { if (Test-Path $f -PathType Leaf) { $content = Get-Content $f -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($content -match 'console\\.log') { Write-Host \"[Hook] WARNING: console.log in $f\" -ForegroundColor Red; $hasConsole = $true } } }; if ($hasConsole) { Write-Host '[Hook] Remove console.log before committing' -ForegroundColor Yellow } }; exit 0"

Stop.description: Final audit for console.log and play finish sound
